name: loopback
description: Routes every question the agent has for you to your Loopback inbox, with no prompting: the session is told to ask through Loopback, Claude Code's built-in question prompt is redirected there, and a turn that ends with a question in the conversation is sent back to ask it through Loopback. It holds only hooks: connect Loopback's MCP server as your deployment's /llms.txt says.
